title: MiniMax repeats alternating near-identical drawing crops without saving extraction
review_basis: Original drawing and table visually inspected. Fresh159 native history reviewed; only selected tool arguments retained, no model reasoning/transcript. This is efficiency evidence, not new accuracy score.
failure_oracle: Near-identical crops with small coordinate jitter should receive loop guidance, while every original image remains available and no inspection/repair count cap or weaker PASS is introduced. A tighter detail or changed rotation remains distinct.
